resources.string: Nine Men’s Morris
Take turns placing your pieces on the points, then move them along the lines. Three in a row (a mill) lets you remove one of the computer’s pieces. Leave it with two pieces or with no move to win.
Nine men’s morris
9 pieces each on three squares. With only 3 pieces left, yours can jump to any point.
Six men’s morris
6 pieces each on a smaller board with two squares. No jumping.
Twelve men’s morris
12 pieces each and diagonal lines that also make mills. With 3 pieces left, yours can jump.
